div.head: EGu 6.7
div.ab: ⁊ gyf he gewyrce, þæt hine man afylle, þurh þæt he ongean Godes riht oððe ðæs cynges geonbyrde, gyf man þæt gesoðige, licge ægylde.
⁊ gif he gewyrce, þæt hine man afylle, þurh þæt [þe] he gean Godes ryht oððe þæs cynges geonbyrde, gif man þæt gesoðige, licge ægylde.
Et si efficiat, ut occidatur, pro eo quod contra Dei rectum et regis imperium stet, si hoc inueritetur, iaceat ægylde.
⁊ gif he gewyrce, þæt hine man afylle, þurh þæt [he ongean] Godes ryht oððe þæs cynges geonbyrde, gif man þæt gesoðige, licge ǽgylde.
And gif he gewyrce þæt hine man afylle þurh þæt he ongean Godes ryht oððe þæs cynges geonbyrde, gif man þæt gesoðige, licge ægylde.
If he so acts as to bring about his own death by setting himself against the laws of God and the king, no compensation shall be paid for him, if this can be proved.
And if he acts in such a way as to cause his own death through resistance to God’s justice or the king’s, and if that is shown to be true, no compensation need be paid for him.

Und wenn er bewirkt, dass man ihn erschlägt, weil er gegen die Gerechtsame der Kirche oder des Königs ankämpft(e?), wenn dies erwiesen wird, liege er ohne [seiner Sippe durch den Todtschläger] entgolten zu werden.
And if he brings it about that he is slain, because he fights against the dues of the Church or of the king, if this is proved, let him lie without being paid for [to his kin by the slayer].
